name: Standard Sales Order Processing (Happy Path)
expected_outcome: Message routed through SequenceFlow_82, transformed via MessageMapping_102, custom headers set, and terminated successfully at EndEvent_2 with HTTP 202 Accepted
validates: Route evaluation for SalesOrder branch, header enrichment (Region, Country, TimeStamp, BusinessObject, Sender), and message flow execution to EndEvent_2.

name: Sales Order Return Processing (Alternative Happy Path)
expected_outcome: Message routed through SequenceFlow_113 to CallActivity_71, logged via custom header properties, terminated at EndEvent_9 with HTTP 202 Accepted
validates: Route evaluation for SO Return create branch, bypass of MessageMapping_102, and successful completion at EndEvent_9.

name: Routing Condition Not Met (Escalation Path)
trigger: Inbound SOAP message with unmatched OrderTypeCode (e.g., 'UNKNOWN_TYPE') falling through to default route SequenceFlow_110
expected_outcome: Router triggers default SequenceFlow_110 leading to EndEvent_11 with EscalationCode 'RoutingConditionNotMet'
validates: Default routing branch triggers Escalation End Event and raises escalation code 'RoutingConditionNotMet'.

name: Exception Subprocess Trigger on Transformation Failure
trigger: Malformed XML structure triggering a fault during flow execution after property InputPayload is stored
expected_outcome: SubProcess_91 catches error via StartEvent_92, CallActivity_97 restores body from ${property.InputPayload}, CallActivity_100 logs payload, and EndEvent_95 terminates with ErrorEnd
validates: Fault recovery via SubProcess_91, payload preservation from property 'InputPayload', logging activity, and error propagation.

name: Authentication and User Role Enforcement
trigger: Inbound SOAP request with missing or invalid credentials not matching role 'ESBMessaging.send'
expected_outcome: HTTP 401 Unauthorized or HTTP 403 Forbidden returned by SOAP adapter before process execution

name: Payload Size Boundary Condition Violation
trigger: Inbound SOAP body exceeding the configured maximumBodySize threshold of 40MB
expected_outcome: HTTP 413 Payload Too Large or SOAP Fault rejected at adapter level
validates: Adapter boundary enforcement for maximumBodySize (40MB) and maximumAttachmentSize (100MB).
